title: ForgeC2 plugin manifest
description: Schema for a plugin package's manifest.yaml (package schema v2). The authoritative loader is internal/plugin/manifest.go and manifest.Validate(); `go run ./cmd/plugin-check <dir>` applies this schema plus the tier rules (entry file, package digest/signature, WASM ABI surface). Unknown keys are ignored by the loader but may be rejected by future schema revisions, so keep the manifest clean.

name.description: Unique plugin name used by the API, the UI and `requires` lists. Keys the installed plugin and its audit trail.

version.description: Plugin version, free-form but conventionally semver.

type.description: command runs on demand with operator params; hook subscribes to system events; report renders a report object.

description.description: One-line summary shown in the UI.

category.description: Grouping in the UI (recon, credential, report, …).

entry.description: Relative path of the script or module inside the package. Must be relative and must not contain '..'. A wasm interpreter requires a .wasm entry.

interpreter.description: How the entry is executed. python/powershell/bash/go run as native child processes with the server account's reach; wasm runs sandboxed in-process (no WASI, no files, no sockets, 16 MiB memory cap).

timeout.description: Per-run wall-clock limit in seconds; 0 or absent means 60. The server clamps runs at 300s and additionally enforces CPU and write budgets.

params.description: Operator-facing parameters; the UI renders one form field per entry and the values arrive as the `params` object.

type.description: Field type; 'string', 'int', 'number' and 'bool' are the conventional values.

default.description: String form of the default value; the UI casts it to the declared type.

events.description: Hook subscriptions (for example agent.connect, agent.disconnect, task.completed). A hook with an empty list never fires.

config.description: Default configuration handed to the plugin as the `config` object; the operator can override it per install.

requires.description: Plugin names that must load before this one; the loader refuses missing or cyclic dependencies.

digest.description: Canonical package digest, written by cmd/sign-plugin (never by hand).

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the digest string, written by cmd/sign-plugin and verified by the server against plugins.trusted_keys.

includes.description: Extra paths inside the package tree whose files also belong to the digest (for example ["lib"] for a shared helper library). Entries must be relative and must not contain '..'.
